origin_and_scope_limits: No actual phase, model graph, NumPy/PyTensor model evaluation, fit, sampler, normalizer, or forecast was run. Thus no numerical receipt origin or parent0/B parity claim is established yet.

A successful future run still depends on a genuinely fresh, nonconflicting per-phase resource/staging assessment and caller-retained clean controller tool return; no authorization is produced by this review.

Within the stated cooperating workspace, the verified snapshots and chained hashes are suitable reproducibility evidence. They do not defend against hostile same-user execution, arbitrary coherent filesystem rewrites, filesystem rollback/power loss, or mathematical errors in PyTensor/NUMBA.

A→all8→A point evaluations and a fixed-B oracle cannot establish the six remaining fixed-parent equivalences absent an exhaustive reviewed proof or further anchors, and cannot establish any q_i normalizer or calibrated predictive performance.
